Author: Anomek (DevilBike's fork)
Name: AnoMech
Punchline: Another FFXIV mechanics simulator. Go to an inn and start practice.
Description: DevilBike's fork of Anomek's AnoMech: spawns fake party members and bosses client-side so you can practice raid mechanics without a full party. Adds TEA, DSR, M9S-M11S and more strats from other forks.
